capabilities: Generate images from the current selection or a prompt in a modal
Configure a Replicate model and its JSON input
Append generated image URLs as markdown embeds to the note
Copy generated output URLs to the clipboard
extras: Generated images are only stored on Replicate's servers for one hour, so users must download anything they want to keep. Full configuration and troubleshooting docs live in separate files (docs/configuration.md, docs/tips.md), and the README lists many other plugins by the same author plus support/sponsorship options.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to call AI image generation models; users would have to generate images elsewhere and import them manually.

relations.evidence: integrates Replicate.com and enables using the various image generation models supported by Replicate

summary: Replicate.com integration that generates images from a selected prompt or modal input using Replicate-hosted models.
